name: oss_download
description: Download a file from z-oss by bucket and key. Use this when the CEO agent needs to retrieve binary content: a previously uploaded screenshot, an exported report, an archived log. Returns the file content as base64 (or a presigned URL if directUrl=true). Backed by GET /api/v1/object/{bucket}/{key}. Requires z-ctc 'oss:read' permission. For very large files (>10MB), prefer directUrl=true to get a presigned URL instead of pulling the content through the agent.

directUrl.description: If true, return a presigned URL instead of the content. Use for files >10MB. Default false.
